reviews.text: So many cute dog toys and such a good variety. Dangerous place to visit when you have two dogs at home.

My dog he is a long haired Chihuahua was groomed there 2 weeks ago, they dropped him and he sustained a serious injury, at the moment he is in a lot’s of pain. This place caused my dog pain and misery. I will be reporting them and launching an official complaint…
Marty is always going to this Pet Pavilion location for grooming and he always comes back super clean 🫧, smelling good, with perfect tooth 🦷 and all cute. Really great place! …
Great friendly service and great selection of treats!

This place is well stocked. I got wet food for my cat, slow feeder lick mat, and some catnip toys. The shop assistant was really helpful and friendly! (My cat loves the tote bag, thanks!)

There is a 211 bus stop right outside the marketplace.
I can only say good things... my dog ​​is not easy and they treat her with a lot of patience and unparalleled professionalism... thank you very much🙏🤗 …
I have always used this service and it’s a lovely service. Highly recommended
My dog always has a really nice grooming here and he is happy when I pick him up. Definitely  recommend it
